291: He Himself has staged His own drama;
O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ॥1॥
When there was only God the Master,
ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਕਹੁ. ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
then who was called bound or liberated?
When there was only the Lord, unfathomable and infinite,
ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ; ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?
When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,
ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
then where was mind and where was matter — where was Shiva and Shakti?
ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
When He held His own Light unto Himself,
ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ; ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
then who was fearless, and who was afraid?
He Himself is the performer in His own plays;
O Nanak, the Lord Master is unfathomable and infinite. ॥2॥
When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,
ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
then where was birth, death and dissolution?
When there was only God, the perfect Creator,
ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
then who was afraid of death?
When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,
ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ; ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?
When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,
ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ; ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?
He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, He Himself created His own form. ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,
ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ; ਕਹਹੁ. ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?
When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in nirvaana,
ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ; ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
then who was honoured, and who was dishonoured?
When there was only the form of the Lord of the universe,
ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ; ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
then who was tainted by fraud and sin?
ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ; ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His own Light,
then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?
He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.
O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ॥4॥
ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
When His glory was contained within Himself,
ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?
When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,
ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ; ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?
ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ; ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
When He kept Himself, all-in-all, unto His own heart,
then who considered omens to be good or bad?
ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ; ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,
ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
then who was called master, and who was called disciple?
We are wonderstruck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.
O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ॥5॥
When the Undeceivable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,
then who was swayed by Maya?
When He paid homage to Himself,
then the three qualities were not prevailing.
When there was only the One, the One and only Lord God,
ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ; ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?
When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,
then who spoke and who listened?
He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.
O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ॥6॥
When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,
He made the world subject to the three qualities.
Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.
292: Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.
Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,
egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear,
pain and pleasure, honour and dishonour —
these came to be described in various ways.
He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.
He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ॥7॥
Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.
He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His saint.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
His praise is to Himself alone.
He Himself performs His amusements and games.
He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.
ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.
He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.
He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.
ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ॥8॥21॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are pervading everywhere.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the One is all-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ॥1॥
He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
When it pleases Him, He creates the world.
As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.
ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ; ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without You, nothing can be done.
Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
One whom God Himself inspires to understand —
that person obtains the True Name.
He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.
O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ॥1॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
All beings and creatures are in His hands.
He is merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.
ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
No one can destroy those who are protected by Him.
That one is dead, whom He forgets from His mind.
ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ; ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Leaving Him, where could anyone go?
Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.
ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
The ways of all beings are in His hands.
Inside and out, know that He is with you.
He is the ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.
Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ॥2॥
The perfect, merciful Lord is pervading everywhere;
He Himself knows His own ways.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.
He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ; ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
Whatever He has created meditates on Him.
Whoever pleases Him, He mixes into Himself.
ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
They perform His devotional service and sing the glorious praises of the Lord.
With heartfelt faith, they believe in Him;
O Nanak, they realise the One Creator Lord. ॥3॥
God's humble servant is committed to His Name.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
His hopes do not go in vain.
The servant's purpose is to serve;
obeying the Lord's command, the supreme status is obtained.
Beyond this, they have no other thought —
those within whose minds the Formless Lord abides.
Their bonds are cut away, and they become free of hatred.
Night and day, they worship the feet of the Guru.
They are at peace in this world, and happy in the world hereafter.
293: O Nanak, the Lord God unites them with Himself. ॥4॥
Join the company of the holy, and be happy.
Sing the glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.
Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Sing the ambrosial words of the Lord's glorious praises;
this is the way to save your mortal soul.
Twenty-four hours a day, see God near at hand.
Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.
Listen to the teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ॥5॥
Embellish both this world and the next;
enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.
Perfect are the teachings of the perfect Guru.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
That person, within whose mind it abides, realises the Truth.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
With your mind and body, chant the Name; lovingly attune yourself to it.
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.
Deal in the true trade, O trader,
and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.
Keep the support of the One in your mind.
O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ॥6॥
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ; ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?
Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.
Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.
By the grace of God, mortals are released.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.
Chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful.
Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
No one can equal that humble servant.
The brave and powerful Guru stands over his head;
O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ॥7॥
ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
His wisdom is perfect, and His glance is ambrosial.
Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the universe is saved.
His lotus feet are incomparably beautiful.
Fruitful is His Blessed Vision; beautiful is the Lord's form.
Blessed is His service; His servant is approved.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the most exalted Supreme Being.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
One within whose mind He abides is blissfully happy.
ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Death does not draw near him.
Such people become immortal, and obtain the immortal status,
O Nanak, meditating on the Lord in the company of the holy. ॥8॥22॥
ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ. ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.
ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
By the Lord's grace, I have met the saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ॥1॥
In the company of the saints, I see God deep within my being.
God's Name is sweet to me.
All things are contained in the heart of the One,
although they appear in so many various colours.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.
Within the human body is its place of rest.
The deepest trance, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad, are there.
The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.
He alone sees it, whom God Himself reveals it to.
O Nanak, that humble being understands. ॥1॥
The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.
In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld,
in all worlds, He is the perfect Cherisher.
294: In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.
As He commands, so are His creatures' deeds.
He permeates the winds and the waters, and fire.
He is pervading the four corners and the ten directions.
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ; ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
Without Him, there is no place at all.
By the Guru's grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ॥2॥
See Him in the Vedas, the Puranas and the Simritees.
In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.
ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.
He Himself is unwavering — He never wavers.
With absolute power, He plays His play.
His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.
ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
In all light, is His Light.
The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric, through and through.
By the Guru's grace, doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ॥3॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ; ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
In the eye of the saint, everything is God.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
In the heart of the saint, everything is Dharma.
The saint hears words of goodness.
He is absorbed in the all-pervading Lord.
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
This is the way of life of one who knows God.
True are all the words spoken by the holy.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He dwells inside, and outside as well.
O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ॥4॥
He Himself is true, and all that He has made is true.
The whole creation came from God.
As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.
As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and only again.
His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.
As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.
Who is near, and who is far away?
He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.
One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart —
O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ॥5॥
In all forms, He Himself is pervading.
Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.
All the creation is His body.
He Himself listens to His own praise.
The One has created the drama of coming and going.
He made Maya subservient to His will.
In the midst of all, He remains unattached.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
Whatever is said, He Himself says.
By His will we come, and by His will we go.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, when it pleases Him, He absorbs us into Himself. ॥6॥
ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
Whatever comes from Him cannot be bad.
Other than Him, who can do anything?
He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.
He Himself knows His own being.
He Himself is true, and all that He has established is true.
Through and through, He is blended with His creation.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
His state and extent cannot be described.
If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.
His actions are all approved and accepted.
By the Guru's grace, O Nanak, this is known. ॥7॥
ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who knows Him obtains everlasting peace.
God blends that one into Himself.
He is wealthy and prosperous, and of noble birth;
he is liberated while yet alive, in whose heart the Lord God abides.
Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;
295: by whose grace the whole world is carried across.
This alone is the purpose of such a person's coming:
ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
that in their company others come to remember the Name.
Free themselves, they set the world free too.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
O Nanak, to such a person I bow forever. ॥8॥23॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
One who has worshipped the perfect Lord, whose Name is perfect,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
has found the Perfect One; O Nanak, sing the praises of the Perfect One. ॥1॥
Hear the teaching of the perfect Guru,
and behold the Supreme Lord near at hand.
With each and every breath, remember the Lord of the universe,
and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.
Give up the waves of hope for what does not last,
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
and, O mind, beg for the dust of the feet of the saints.
Setting aside your ego, offer your prayer,
and in the company of the holy, cross the ocean of fire.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ; ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Fill your storehouses with the wealth of the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, bow to the perfect Guru. ॥1॥
Lasting comfort, poise and bliss are found
by meditating in the company of the holy on the Lord of supreme bliss.
Keep hell far away and save your soul:
sing the virtues of the Lord, and drink the nectar of the Name.
Fix your mind in meditation on the One Lord,
ਏਕ ਰੂਪ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
who is One in form, yet has countless colours.
The Sustainer of the world, the Lord, merciful to the meek,
destroyer of sorrow, all-pervading and full of mercy —
remember His Name again and again.
O Nanak, this alone is the support of the soul. ॥2॥
The words of the Guru are the most sublime hymns of praise;
they are priceless rubies and jewels.
Hearing them and living by them, one is saved;
one swims across oneself and carries others across too.
ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ; ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Fruitful is that person's life, and fruitful is their company,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
whose mind is imbued with the Lord's love.
Within them resounds, unbroken, the Word of triumph,
ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
and hearing it they rejoice, for God's light shines forth within them.
The Sustainer Lord becomes manifest on the forehead of one of exalted conduct;
O Nanak, many are saved along with such a person. ॥3॥
Hearing that You are able to give refuge, I have come to Your refuge;
in Your mercy, God, You have united me with Yourself.
ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ; ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
My enmities are erased, and I have become the dust of the feet of all;
in the company of the holy, I repeat the life-giving Name.
The divine Guru has become fully pleased,
and the service of His servant has been fulfilled.
I am free of worldly entanglements and vices;
hearing the Lord's Name, I chant it with my tongue.
Granting His grace, God has shown me mercy;
O Nanak, my merchandise has reached its destination safely. ॥4॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
O saintly friends, sing the praises of God,
with attention, and with your mind focused on one point.
The Sukhmani, the jewel of peace, is the poise of the Lord's praises and His Name;
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
one within whose mind it dwells becomes a treasure of virtue.
ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
All that person's desires are fulfilled;
they become a leading person, renowned throughout the world.
They obtain the highest place of all,
and they do not come and go in birth and death again.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ; ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
That person departs having earned the wealth of the Lord's Name —
O Nanak, the one who is destined to receive it. ॥5॥
Lasting comfort, tranquillity, wealth, the nine treasures,
intellect, wisdom and all spiritual powers;
learning, austerity, Yoga, meditation on God,
296: the most sublime wisdom, the most excellent cleansing bath;
the four great blessings, the blossoming of the heart-lotus;
ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ; ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
living among all, yet detached from all;
beauty, wisdom, and knowing the essence of reality;
looking on all alike, and seeing the One in all —
ਇਹ ਫਲ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
these fruits come to the person who speaks with their mouth
ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ; ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
and hears with their mind the Guru Nanak's word of the Name. ॥6॥
Whoever chants this treasure in their mind
ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
is spiritually elevated throughout their life.
Their speech is the Lord's virtues and the melody of the Name;
so the Simritees, the Shastras and the Vedas declare.
The essence of all doctrines is the Lord's Name alone;
it dwells in the mind of the Lord's devotee.
Millions of sins are erased in the company of the holy;
ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
by the saint's grace, one escapes the messenger of death.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Those on whose foreheads God has inscribed His grace,
O Nanak, they come to the refuge of the Guru. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
One within whose mind it dwells, who listens to it with love —
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
that person remembers the Lord God.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
The pain of their birth and death is removed;
the precious human body is redeemed at once.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Spotless is their glory, and their speech is ambrosial,
for the One Name fills their mind.
Sorrow, disease, fear and doubt depart;
ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
they are called holy, and their deeds are spotless.
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
Their glory becomes the highest of all.
O Nanak, by these virtues the Name is called Sukhmani, the jewel of peace. ॥8॥24॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ; ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
The Lord, the Creator, is pervading the water, the land and the sky.
ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the One Creator has spread Himself out in so many ways. ॥1॥
ਏਕਮ. ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
The first day: meditating on the One Creator God, I bow before Him.
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
I sing the virtues of the Lord of the universe, the Sustainer, and seek the refuge of the Sovereign Lord.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ. ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ; ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Hope in Him, from whom all things come, brings peace and happiness.
ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
I have wandered the four corners and ten directions; without Him, there is no other.
ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
I have listened to the Vedas, the Puranas and the Simritees, and reflected on them in many ways:
ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ. ਭੈ ਹਰਨ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
the Formless Lord alone is the saviour of the fallen, the dispeller of fear, the ocean of peace.
ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He is the Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower; without Him there is no other place to go.
ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
Whatever you wish for, you shall obtain, O Nanak, by singing the Lord's praises. ॥1॥
Sing the praises of the Lord of the universe each and every day;
ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
join the company of the holy and meditate on Him, my friend. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਵਾਰ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Again and again I bow before Him, and seek the refuge of the Sovereign Lord.
ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ. ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, in the company of the holy, doubt is dispelled, and the love of duality is erased. ॥2॥
ਦੁਤੀਆ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ. ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
The second day: rid yourself of evil-mindedness, and serve the Guru always.
ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
Give up lust, anger and greed, my friend, and the jewel of the Lord's Name will dwell in your mind and body.
ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
Death is overcome, spiritual life is obtained, and all troubles are dispelled.
ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
Give up your ego and meditate on the Lord of the universe; loving devotion will enter within you.
297: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
You will earn profit, your losses will be wiped away, and you will be honoured in the Lord's Court.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ; ਸਾਚ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Those who gather the wealth of the Lord's Name become truly wealthy and fortunate bankers.
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord, and cherish love for the company of the holy.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਗਈ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਸੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, evil-mindedness departs when the Supreme Lord dwells in the mind. ॥2॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ; ਤੁਰੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
The three qualities hold sway over the world; only rare is the one who attains the fourth state.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ; ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, the saints become pure, within whose minds the Lord dwells. ॥3॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ. ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖੈ ਫਲ; ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
The third day: under the three qualities, people gather the fruits of vice — now high, now low.
ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਉ ਘਣੋ; ਸਦਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
They wander through heaven and hell, and death keeps destroying them.
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
Through pleasure, pain and fear, their life passes in ego.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ. ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
They do not know the One who made them, and think up all sorts of other schemes.
ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਸ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾਪ ॥
Through the cravings of the world, afflictions of mind and body and strife cling to them; their torment never ends.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ; ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
They do not understand the glory of the Supreme Lord, the perfect Master.
ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਬੂਡਤ ਘਣੋ; ਮਹਾ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥
So many are drowning in attachment and doubt, dwelling in the most terrible hell.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
Bestow Your mercy, God, and save me; Nanak places his hope in You. ॥3॥
ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Clever, wise and refined is the one who has given up ego.
ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ; ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
The four great blessings and the eight spiritual powers are found by meditating, O Nanak, on the Lord's Name. ॥4॥
ਚਤੁਰਥਿ, ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ; ਸੋਧਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
The fourth day: having heard all four Vedas, I have examined their essence and reflected on it:
ਸਰਬ ਖੇਮ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
the treasure of all comfort and well-being is found by chanting the sublime Name of the Lord.
ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ. ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ; ਤੂਟਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
It saves one from hell, removes pain, and countless troubles are ended.
ਮੀਚੁ ਹੁਟੈ. ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
Spiritual death is overcome and one is freed from Yama, when the Lord's praise enters the heart.
ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੈ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Fear is dispelled and the nectar is savoured, when one is dyed in the love of the Formless Lord.
ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ; ਨਾਸਹਿ. ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Pain, poverty and impurity are destroyed by the support of the Name.
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ. ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤੇ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
The Sustainer of the world, the ocean of peace, whom angelic beings and silent sages search for —
ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ; ਹੋਇ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੪॥
the mind becomes pure and the face radiant, O Nanak, by becoming the dust of the feet of the holy. ॥4॥
ਪੰਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ. ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ; ਰਾਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
The five vices dwell in the minds of those engrossed in Maya.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੫॥
In the company of the holy, one becomes pure, O Nanak, dyed in God's love. ॥5॥
ਪੰਚਮਿ. ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ; ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ॥
The fifth day: they are the chosen ones, who know the nature of the world:
ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ. ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣੋ; ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਲਬੰਚੁ ॥
like the fragrance of flowers, it has so many colours, yet all of it is false and deceptive.
ਨਹ ਜਾਪੈ. ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
People do not see, they do not understand, and they do not reflect on anything.
ਸੁਆਦ ਮੋਹ ਰਸ ਬੇਧਿਓ; ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
The world is pierced by the flavours of taste and attachment, engrossed in ignorance.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ. ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਣ; ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Doing countless other deeds, they are caught in birth and death, wandering through many lives.
ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ. ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ; ਮਨਿ. ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
They do not remember the Creator, nor develop discernment in their minds.
ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ. ਰੰਚ ॥
Those who are in loving devotion to the Lord, untouched by Maya even slightly —
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ; ਜੋ. ਨ ਰਚਹਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, how rare are those who are not engrossed in the world's display. ॥5॥
ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ. ਊਚੌ ਕਹਹਿ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
The six Shastras proclaim aloud that He has no end or limit.
ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬॥
The devotees look beautiful, O Nanak, singing His praises at God's door. ॥6॥
ਖਸਟਮਿ. ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਹਹਿ; ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
The sixth day: the six Shastras speak of Him, and many Simritees describe Him;
298: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਗੁਣ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
the Supreme Lord is sublime and high; even the countless Shesh-naags do not know the limit of His virtues.
ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ; ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Naarad, the silent sages, Sukdev and Vyaas sing the praises of the Lord of the universe.
ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੀਧੇ; ਭਗਤ ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
The devotees are steeped in His essence, pierced through by the Lord, absorbed in God.
ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ; ਪਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Attachment, pride and doubt are destroyed for those who have found the refuge of the Merciful One.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
His lotus feet dwell in their minds and bodies; beholding His vision, they are delighted.
ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Profit is earned and loss is wiped away by fixing one's mind on Him in the company of the holy.
ਖਾਟਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
Gather the treasure of the Lord, the treasure of virtues; O Nanak, meditate on the Name. ॥6॥
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਹਿ; ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
The congregation of saints speaks the Lord's praise, telling His truth with love.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ; ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, the mind is content when one attunes oneself to the One. ॥7॥
ਸਪਤਮਿ. ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ; ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ. ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
The seventh day: gather the wealth of the Name; its storehouses never run out.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
It is obtained in the company of the saints; His end and limit cannot be found.
ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Give up your self-conceit, meditate on the Lord of the universe, and seek the refuge of the Sovereign Lord.
ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ. ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Pain is removed, one crosses the terrifying world-ocean, and obtains the fruit of the mind's desires.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ; ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
One who chants the Lord's Name in their mind twenty-four hours a day — their life is fruitful and approved.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Recognise the Creator, who is always with you, within and without.
ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ. ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਜੋ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
That one is a friend, a companion and a dear one, who gives the wisdom of the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ ॥੭॥
Nanak is a sacrifice to the one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥7॥
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ; ਤਜੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Sing His praises twenty-four hours a day, and give up all other entanglements.
ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ. ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੮॥
The messenger of death cannot even look at you, O Nanak, when God becomes merciful. ॥8॥
The eighth day: the eight spiritual powers, the nine treasures,
the blossoming of the heart-lotus, and constant bliss;
a pure way of life, and a mantra that never fails;
all righteousness, and the purifying cleansing bath;
the highest and most distinguished wisdom of all —
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
these come from meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, in the company of the perfect Guru.
ਜਪਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ; ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥
O Nanak, chanting the Name in the Lord's love, one is carried across. ॥8॥
ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ. ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ; ਮੋਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
One who does not remember the Lord is enticed by the tastes of vice.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ; ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੯॥
O Nanak, forgetting the Name, one is born again and again into heaven and hell. ॥9॥
The ninth day: the nine openings of the body are defiled,
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਜਪਹਿ; ਕਰਤ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
in those who do not chant the Lord's Name and do perverse deeds.
ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਮਹਿ; ਬਕਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਿੰਦ ॥
They commit adultery with others' wives and slander the holy.
ਕਰਨ. ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
Their ears do not hear the Lord's praise even for a moment.
ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ; ਉਦਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
They steal the wealth of others for the sake of their bellies,
ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਨਿਵਰੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ. ਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
yet the fire is not put out, and their thirst is not quenched.
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ; ਏਹ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Without the Lord's service, these are the fruits obtained.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੯॥
O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate ones die and are born again. ॥9॥
ਦਸ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ. ਮੈ ਫਿਰਿਓ; ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
I have wandered searching in the ten directions; wherever I look, there He is.
ਮਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ. ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜੇ. ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
The mind comes under control, O Nanak, only if the Lord bestows His perfect grace. ॥10॥
The tenth day: one brings the ten senses under control;
contentment comes to the mind by chanting the Name.
With the ears one hears the praises of the Sustainer of the world;
with the eyes one beholds the merciful Guru;
the tongue sings the praises of the Infinite Lord;
and in the mind one contemplates the all-pervading Lord God.
299: With the hands and feet, one performs service for the saints.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
O Nanak, this discipline is obtained only by God's grace. ॥10॥
ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ; ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ॥
Speak of the One and only Lord; rare is the one who knows the taste of it.
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧੧॥
The virtues of the Lord of the universe cannot be known; O Nanak, He is all wonder. ॥11॥
The eleventh day: see the Lord near at hand.
ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Bring your senses under control, and listen to the Lord's Name.
Let your mind be content, and be kind to all beings;
in this way, your fast is fulfilled.
Keep your wandering mind in one place,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ; ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
and your mind and body become pure, chanting the Lord's Name.
The Supreme Lord is pervading in all;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਅਟਲ ਏਹੁ ਧਰਮ ॥੧੧॥
O Nanak, sing the Lord's praises; this alone is unfailing righteousness. ॥11॥
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੀ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ; ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Evil-mindedness is removed, by serving the merciful Guru upon meeting Him.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, those who remain merged with God are freed of all entanglements. ॥12॥
The twelfth day: give in charity, chant the Name, and keep your life pure.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ; ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Worship the Lord with devotion, and give up your pride.
Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name in the company of the holy.
The mind is satisfied by singing God's praises with love.
The sweet words of His Bani bring contentment to all.
ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਪੋਖੈ ॥
The soul, made of the five elements, is nourished by the essence of the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਏਹ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
This gift is surely obtained from the perfect Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, dwelling on the Lord, one does not enter the womb again. ॥12॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ. ਕਾਮ ॥
Engrossed in the three qualities, one's desires are never fulfilled.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੩॥
When the Saviour of the fallen dwells in the mind, O Nanak, one is saved through the Name. ॥13॥
The thirteenth day: the world is afflicted by the three fevers.
It comes and goes, born again and again into hell.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ; ਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, does not enter the mind;
ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
not even for an instant does one sing the praises of God, the ocean of peace.
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ; ਦੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥
One has made the body a bundle of pleasure and pain,
and suffers the long, incurable disease of Maya.
By day, one wears oneself out committing vices;
and with sleep in the eyes, one mutters in dreams.
Forgetting the Lord, this is one's condition.
Nanak seeks the refuge of God, the merciful Primal Being. ॥13॥
ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ. ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਨ; ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
In the four directions and the fourteen worlds, the Lord is pervading everywhere.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਊਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ; ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, no shortage is seen in Him; all His works are perfect. ॥14॥
The fourteenth day: God Himself is in the four directions;
His glory is perfect in all realms.
The One God is pervading the ten directions.
ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
Behold God in the earth, the sky and in all.
In the water, on the land, in the forests, mountains and nether regions —
there the Merciful Transcendent Lord dwells.
The Lord God is in all, the subtle and the manifest.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh recognises God everywhere. ॥14॥
ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Conquering the self through the Guru's teaching, one sings the praises of the Lord of the universe.
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧੫॥
By the Guru's grace, fears are dispelled, O Nanak, and anxiety is destroyed. ॥15॥
ਅਮਾਵਸ. ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਏ; ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
The night of the new moon: the soul is at peace when the divine Guru blesses one with contentment.
300: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ; ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Mind and body are cooled, with tranquillity and poise, when one is committed to God's service.
ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ; ਸਫਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
The bonds of so many vices are broken, and all one's tasks are fulfilled and successful.
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਟੀ. ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
Evil-mindedness is erased and ego is shed, remembering the Name of the Lord.
ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ॥
One who has grasped the refuge of the Supreme Lord is rid of coming and going.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ. ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ; ਗੁਣ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਵਨ ॥
Singing the praises of God, the Lord of the universe, one is carried across together with one's family.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ; ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Perform service for the Lord, and chant the Name of God.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੫॥
Through the perfect Guru, O Nanak, the home of peace is found. ॥15॥
ਪੂਰਨੁ. ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ; ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ॥
The perfect one never wavers, whom God Himself has made perfect.
ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧੬॥
Day by day such a person flourishes more and more; O Nanak, they never fall short. ॥16॥
ਪੂਰਨਮਾ. ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ; ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
The day of the full moon: the One God alone is perfect, the all-powerful Cause of causes.
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
The all-pervading Lord is kind to all beings and creatures; His protecting hand is over all.
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ; ਕੀਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
The Lord of the universe, the Great One, is the treasure of virtues; all that happens is His doing.
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ; ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
God is the Inner-knower, all-wise, unseen and immaculate.
The Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Master, knows every way.
ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
He is the help of the saints, able to give refuge; bow to Him twenty-four hours a day.
ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ. ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਸਿਮਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥
His story cannot be told, nor can He be understood; meditate on the feet of the Lord.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੧੬॥
Saviour of the fallen, Master of the masterless — O Nanak, seek the refuge of God. ॥16॥
ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਓ; ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Pain is destroyed and fear is gone for one who grasps the refuge of the Sovereign Lord.
ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
They obtain the fruits of their mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Lord's praises. ॥17॥
ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ; ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Whoever sings of Him, whoever listens, whoever reflects on Him,
ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ. ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
whoever teaches others and firmly implants it within — that person is saved.
ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ. ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Their sins are cut away, they become pure, and the filth of countless lifetimes departs.
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ; ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ. ਮਾਇ ॥
Their face is radiant in this world and the next, and Maya does not touch them.
ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ. ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ; ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
They are the truly aware, the true Vaishnav, the spiritually wise and the wealthy;
ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
they are the true hero and of noble family, who meditate on the Lord God.
ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ; ਉਧਰੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
Khatri, Brahmin, Shudra or Vaishya, or even an outcaste — all are saved by remembering Him.
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧੭॥
Nanak is the dust of the feet of whoever has come to know their God. ॥17॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ. ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
The True Guru is kind; all are alike to Him.
ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ; ਮਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਤੇ. ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
He looks on all with an equal eye, yet success comes according to the faith of one's own mind.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ. ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Within the True Guru is the nectar of the sublime Name of the Lord, and the Lord's exalted state.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, by His grace one meditates on the Lord; only a rare one obtains it by turning to the Guru. ॥1॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Ego born of Maya is pure poison; following it, there is constant loss in the world.
ਲਾਹਾ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
The profit of the Lord's wealth is earned by turning to the Guru and reflecting on the Word.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਤਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
The poison of the filth of ego is removed by enshrining the Lord's nectar in the heart.
